objective: Bring the Defiant Orc Head to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.

description: Vigorous digging reveals the head of a male orc, raggedly severed at the neck.  His lips are frozen in a snarl, and its dark eyes stare defiantly.
progress: You have another matter to report, <name>?
completion: This is the head of Marg Nighteye! As I feared, he is dead.
Look at the wound on his neck! Could a weapon have made that ragged cut, or did some beast slay our agent?
This is a mystery we must solve, <name>. We must discover if Marg's death was at the hands of the Alliance!
